translations.text: O God of the elements, I beseech you: you are my beloved confidant, full of grace. Do not turn your face away from me, for you are my judgment, free of betrayal.
You are my king; you are my law; my heart is yours, my body is yours. I love you, O Christ free from bondage, for my soul is yours tonight.
I will not hide it, O King: may I be in your royal house all my life; may I partake of the feast from your table; do not leave me behind you, O God.
